Short title and commencement

CANAL AND DRAINAGE
CANAL AND DRAINAGE
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 18th June, 2002]
No. Legis. 13‑39/99,
dated 18‑6‑2002.‑‑ The following Ordinance promulgated
by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Canal and
Drainage (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 35 of Act VIII of 1873

by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment in section 35 of
Act VIII of 1873.‑‑In the said Act, in section 35 subsection
(3), in clauses (i) and (ii) the word "three" shall be substituted by
the word "ten".
